name: Gareth Pryce

intro.text: Ah. Cardiff. Our offices are just up there, the glass ones. You may have seen the sign. It says 'Synergy'.
I have reviewed Llanberis. I have reviewed Yr Wyddfa. Overall performance: below target. I attribute this to you.
Today I am restructuring you. Out of the Stones, and into the history books. Politely, of course.

win: Noted. Escalating. Not to a manager, you understand. To a larger spreadsheet.
after: I shall be taking some leave. Somewhere with no mountains. And no you.
